project.name: Herd / C2 «Толпа против рынка» — root aggregator
project.description: Root Maven aggregator (предложение, docs/research/server_design.md): lets a single `mvn -s ~/.m2/settings-oss.xml -f pom.xml ... ` build engine and server together in reactor/dependency order. Neither module has this project as its Maven <parent> — engine/pom.xml is untouched (project rule: only additive changes to engine/), and both modules stay independently buildable from their own directory exactly as before (`cd engine && mvn ...`, `cd server && mvn ...`).
